blocks.text: A new pedestrian bridge now connects City di Mare (CDM) and IL Corso across the Cebu South Road Properties, as CDM officially inaugurated the CDM Link on September 18, 2026, led by City di Mare Deputy General Manager Gwen Sala, Filinvest Townships Head and First Vice President Don Don Mari Ubaldo, and Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival. The bridge is designed to make crossing safer and more convenient for pedestrians and cyclists while adding a new visual landmark to one of Cebu City’s busiest southern corridors.
